issue.title: Improve policy validation, add policy deletion.
issue.body:
This adds better policy validation and persistence handling, along with policy deletion.

Test did fail for me with TestInstantiation errors. See https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/5878#issuecomment-559834520. This is fixed with Quarkus 1.0

Signed-off-by: Heiko W. Rupp <hrupp@redhat.com>

body: Thanks for reporting the issue! I totally forgot about it. Multi-Catch was indeed my solution!
@stuartwdouglas could it be related to incorrect bytecode generation?

Hello @pilhuhn,
Is this class:
```
com/redhat/cloud/custompolicies/app/EngineResponseExceptionMapper
```
available for reference somewhere in github or some other place?
Never mind, I found that class in your PR in the other repo here https://github.com/RedHatInsights/custom-policies-ui-backend/pull/6/files
I am planning on hoping to take a look at this today if I can get all other things done :P

I have added my analysis [here](https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187030-users/topic/Caused.20by.3A.20java.2Elang.2EVerifyError.3A.20.20Bad.20type.20on.20operand.20stack/near/182474717). It looks like a Panache (or even an ASM) issue to me.
I bet it's due to `QuarkusClassWriter.getCommonSuperClass` trying to find the common supertype between the exception types and we return `Object`. I don't know how to fix it, though.

That sounds very reasonable!

I didn't know about that one to be honest. I can take a look at it tomorrow, maybe a fresh pair of eyes will help
